title: Opus vermiculatum tesserae mosaic
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of opus vermiculatum mosaic: rows of small tesserae that ring round motifs, outline them and fill the background, meeting along irregular seams, in stone, terracotta or glass smalti with metallic gold. Use for Roman and Byzantine floors, walls, pools and panels.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python mosaic_tesserae.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: motifs
parameters.meaning: Round motifs scattered over the tile.

parameters.name: motif_size
parameters.meaning: Mean motif radius in tile widths.

parameters.name: tessera_size
parameters.meaning: Side of one tessera in tile widths.

parameters.name: grout_width
parameters.meaning: Joint between tesserae as a share of the tessera size.

parameters.name: irregularity
parameters.meaning: Random trimming and tilt of each tessera, as hand-cut pieces have.

parameters.name: outline_rows
parameters.meaning: Rings of outline colour around each motif.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Uneven heights of the tesserae in the bedding mortar.

parameters.name: gloss
parameters.meaning: 0 matte stone tesserae, 1 glossy glass smalti.

parameters.name: colour_variation
parameters.meaning: Spread of tone between tesserae of one colour.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Roman stone mosaic: cream background rows around ochre and red motifs with dark outlines.

presets.name: gold_smalti
presets.description: Byzantine glass smalti: metallic gold background rows around blue and green motifs.

presets.name: sea_rings
presets.description: Teal and blue rings rippling around small white motifs, no outline.

presets.name: earth_stone
presets.description: Large matte stone tesserae in earth tones with wide joints.

limits: Motifs are discs, so every row is a ring around one disc; figurative designs, borders and andamento along arbitrary curves are out of scope. Tesserae are annular sectors trimmed by random amounts, an approximation of hand-cut squares, and the innermost rings of a motif hold a few wedge-shaped pieces. Gold smalti are drawn as metallic gold faces, not glass over leaf. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Signed distance to the nearest disc on a torus
Rings of constant width from quantized distance (andamento following outlines)
Whole numbers of tesserae per ring from the ring circumference
Per-tessera hashing for trims, tilt, lift and colour
Tileable Poisson disc placement of motifs
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
